new_jobs.title: Staff AI Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

The Role

Code Metal's engineering teams are building AI-driven code transpilation, modernization, optimization, modeling and simulation solutions. They all need the same foundations: models to serve, agents to run, context to manage, and results to measure. Our AI Platform team builds those foundations.

As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, you'll be a technical lead on this team. You'll architect and build the AI enablement stack our engineers depend on, from GPU inference serving and model gateway up through agent harnesses, context engineering, observability, and AI experimentation management. It is an internal platform, but we're building it to product standard.

This is an engineering role first. Most of your time goes to designing, building, and operating production systems. You'll also need solid data science and AI research fundamentals: you'll work closely with our AI Research team, and you'll sometimes run experiments yourself when a platform decision needs evidence.

Core Responsibilities

Set the technical direction and architecture for Code Metal's AI platform and the team building it. Own the design docs and RFCs, help with build-vs-buy decisions, and align with other technical stakeholders.
Deploy, benchmark, and tune elastic, production inference for open-weight models on runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM.
Own the model gateway that teams use to reach self-hosted and commercial models, with consistent auth, routing, failover, quotas, and cost attribution.
Design reusable agent harnesses and orchestration primitives that product teams can compose into reliable, verifiable workflows.
Build context-engineering services for memory, retrieval, and data discovery, so agents get the information specific to their tasks.
Instrument the stack end to end, for example, with OpenTelemetry traces and service metrics. Build the experiment-tracking and artifact layer that lets engineers and researchers reproduce and compare results.
Design for productization from day one (versioned APIs, security, deployment in customer environments), and communicate with business and product teams about the roadmap.

Required Qualifications

Production-grade Python and strong platform engineering fundamentals: API and service design, distributed systems, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD, and testing.
Shipped production agentic systems, with a clear sense of where they break and how to make them reliable.
Experience with context engineering: retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector / hybrid search, and memory for agents, ideally over code or large technical corpora.
Experience instrumenting services (for example, with OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics) and operating AI services against SLOs.
Solid data science and AI research fundamentals: how transformers and LLM inference work, experiment design, benchmarking, and model evaluation. Working familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face, and experience fine-tuning, evaluating, or serving language models.
Staff-level technical leadership: owned architecture across multiple systems or teams, written design docs and RFCs, turned ambiguous needs from several internal customers into a roadmap, and mentored engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

Highly desirable: Production experience running an LLM gateway or proxy such as SMG or Bifrost, or equivalent experience building an API gateway, including routing, auth, rate limiting, quotas, failover, and cost attribution.
Hands-on experience deploying and tuning LLM inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM on GPU infrastructure, with measurable gains in throughput, latency, or cost per token.
Familiarity with inference optimization: speculative decoding, prefix caching, tensor/pipeline/expert parallelism, disaggregated prefill and decode, GPU profiling.
Experience building evaluation harnesses for LLMs and agents, and experiment-tracking or artifact management systems such as MLflow or Weights & Biases.
Experience taking an internal platform to an external product: multi-tenancy, SDKs, versioned APIs, and documentation.
Experience deploying AI systems on-prem or in regulated domains such as defense or aerospace.

Experience Level

Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years building and operating ML/AI or LLM systems in production, with demonstrated Staff-level scope and impact.

Pay depends on experience, but we strive to be at the upper end of the salary range
Health care plan with 100% premium coverage, including medical, dental, and vision

to help architect, design, validate, and evolve the network infrastructure supporting Groq's rapidly growing AI compute environments.

As a Sr./Staff Network Design Engineer, you will own network architecture and design across high-performance data center and AI infrastructure environments. You will translate capacity, performance, reliability, and business requirements into scalable network designs that can be deployed and operated consistently.

This role requires deep expertise in data center networking, routing protocols, network architecture, automation, and large-scale infrastructure. You will work closely with network operations, data center engineering, compute, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to take designs from concept through validation and production deployment.

You will also help establish the engineering standards, design patterns, tooling, and technical direction that allow Groq's network infrastructure to scale.

new_jobs.description:
Principal Solutions Architect, Physical AI & Robotics Deployment

About Noble Machines

Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real-world problems, we'd love to talk.

About The Role

We're looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to help customers put Moby, our general-purpose robot, to work in their operations. You'll turn customer needs into achievable applications, customize and integrate the platform, and lead deployments from discovery through production and long-term adoption.

This is a customer-facing, high-ownership role that connects Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You'll need a practical understanding of robotic perception, learning, and autonomous action, and the ability to explain capabilities, limitations, and deployment decisions clearly to engineers and executives alike.

You might come from robotics deployment, application engineering, autonomy, systems integration, or solutions architecture. Formal pre-sales experience matters less than proven ownership of real robot deployments and strong communication skills. As Noble Machines grows, this role can expand into building and leading an Application Engineering team.

What You'll Do

Lead discovery and solution design. Learn customer workflows, operating environments, constraints, and business goals, and assess where Moby fits and what customization and integration it needs.
Architect the deployment. Develop solution architectures, deployment plans, technical success criteria, and risk assessments.
Set clear expectations. Present technical concepts, demos, and recommendations to engineering teams and executive stakeholders, and be candid about platform capabilities and deployment readiness.
Own deployments end to end. Lead engagements from technical evaluation and proof of concept through pilot, production, and ongoing improvement.
Customize and integrate Moby. Work with perception, learning, autonomy, and controls teammates to connect sensor inputs and task requirements to reliable robot behavior.
Troubleshoot across the stack. Resolve hardware, software, sensor, and AI integration issues alongside Engineering.
Prove performance. Define and validate measures for task completion, reliability, and failure recovery against agreed customer acceptance criteria.
Close the loop. Partner with Sales on evaluations and proposals, turn customer requirements into actionable work for Engineering and Product, and bring field findings into the roadmap.
Build for scale. Create repeatable deployment methods, documentation, and best practices, and mentor colleagues as the Application Engineering function grows.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
Personal ownership of AI-enabled physical robot deployments, with clear examples of your technical contributions, decisions, and results.
Practical experience with robotic perception, learning, and autonomous behavior in real-world applications.
Working understanding of vision-language-action (VLA) models and how visual inputs, task instructions, and learned behaviors translate into robot actions.
Experience integrating and troubleshooting robotic hardware, software, sensors, and AI capabilities.
A track record of taking deployments from evaluation or pilot to reliable operation, including the challenges you hit and how you solved them.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with credibility in front of customers, engineers, and executives.
Ability to work across technical and commercial teams in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.
Willingness to travel to customer sites and to work on-site in Sunnyvale regularly.

Candidates with fewer years of experience are encouraged to apply if they bring the technical depth, deployment ownership, and communication skills above.

Nice to Have

Advanced degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience deploying humanoids, autonomous mobile robots, mobile manipulation, or other AI-enabled physical systems.
Hands-on experience integrating, adapting, or evaluating VLA models, learned policies, or perception systems on physical robots.
Experience with simulation, robot learning workflows, and sim-to-real transfer.
Experience leading customer discovery, technical demos, proofs of concept, or enterprise solution design.
Experience supporting industrial customers in construction, mining, energy, manufacturing, or logistics.
Experience mentoring engineers or building an Application Engineering team.

California Pay Transparency Statement

Pay Transparency & Compensation: In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Act (SB 1162), the expected base salary range for this position located in Sunnyvale, CA is $200,000 – $350,000 per year, in addition to bonus, equity, and benefits.

Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, technical skills, and specialized expertise. Base salary is just one component of Noble Machines' total rewards package, which may also include equity options, comprehensive healthcare benefits, retirement plan contributions, and performance-based incentives. Relocation assistance may be available. Exceptional U.S.-based candidates who need an alternative location arrangement will be considered individually.

Share your resume and one or two deployments you personally owned. Tell us what the customer needed, the decisions you made, what went wrong along the way, and how the robot performed in production.

new_jobs.title: Staff AI Platform Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

The Role

Code Metal's engineering teams are building AI-driven code transpilation, modernization, optimization, modeling and simulation solutions. They all need the same foundations: models to serve, agents to run, context to manage, and results to measure. Our AI Platform team builds those foundations.

As a Staff AI Platform Engineer, you'll be a technical lead on this team. You'll architect and build the AI enablement stack our engineers depend on, from GPU inference serving and model gateway up through agent harnesses, context engineering, observability, and AI experimentation management. It is an internal platform, but we're building it to product standard.

This is an engineering role first. Most of your time goes to designing, building, and operating production systems. You'll also need solid data science and AI research fundamentals: you'll work closely with our AI Research team, and you'll sometimes run experiments yourself when a platform decision needs evidence.

Core Responsibilities

Set the technical direction and architecture for Code Metal's AI platform and the team building it. Own the design docs and RFCs, help with build-vs-buy decisions, and align with other technical stakeholders.
Deploy, benchmark, and tune elastic, production inference for open-weight models on runtimes such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM.
Own the model gateway that teams use to reach self-hosted and commercial models, with consistent auth, routing, failover, quotas, and cost attribution.

Design for productization from day one (versioned APIs, security, deployment in customer environments), and communicate with business and product teams about the roadmap.

Required Qualifications

Production-grade Python and strong platform engineering fundamentals: API and service design, distributed systems, containers and Kubernetes, CI/CD, and testing.
Shipped production agentic systems, with a clear sense of where they break and how to make them reliable.
Experience with context engineering: retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector / hybrid search, and memory for agents, ideally over code or large technical corpora.
Experience instrumenting services (for example, with OpenTelemetry tracing and metrics) and operating AI services against SLOs.
Solid data science and AI research fundamentals: how transformers and LLM inference work, experiment design, benchmarking, and model evaluation. Working familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face, and experience fine-tuning, evaluating, or serving language models.

At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

At Warner Music Group, our Strategic Finance team serves as the analytical engine that drives both our high-level business strategy and day-to-day operations. By extracting actionable intelligence from core financial data, the team partners seamlessly across Warner Music’s Central Functions, Recorded Music, and Music Publishing to uncover deep business insights. Ultimately, Strategic Finance sits at the forefront of the company, mapping the financial dynamics and emerging trends that are actively shaping the future of the global music industry.

Your role:

As the Data Scientist for Strategic Finance, you will act as the crucial link between our financial strategists and the Technology department. A key part of your mission is collaborating closely with the technology engineers and data scientists who are building our state-of-the-art predictive forecasting platform, ensuring the tool perfectly aligns with business needs. Alongside this, you will deploy modern AI solutions to automate complex financial workflows and transform ambiguous, disparate data into standardized, cohesive datasets—moving the department away from fragile legacy spreadsheets and toward a highly automated, self-service data ecosystem.

Here you’ll get to:

Partner closely with Technology and Affiliate Finance teams to gather requirements, design, and deploy a robust financial forecasting and planning tool that supports WMG's long-term modeling.
Spearhead AI and automation initiatives to eliminate manual bottlenecks and streamline workflows across Strategic Finance.
Enforce data integrity within Strategic Finance by collaborating with data management teams to architect datasets and automate rigorous quality controls.
Work directly with senior finance collaborators to clarify complex problems and build the right analytical or technology-based approaches using large, dynamic datasets.
Act as the trusted liaison between Strategic Finance, Technology, and data platform collaborators to ensure all technical solutions perfectly align with business priorities.

About you:

Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
3-5 years of hands-on, practical experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks), Python-based automation, internal app frameworks (Streamlit), BI/reporting tools, workflow automation platforms (Airtable), and AI-assisted development tools.
Experience helping teams adopt new tools, new processes, and more modern ways of working while staying grounded in business realities.
Demonstrated ability to lead and implement data science projects with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and model development.
Experience with machine learning frameworks and statistical tools.
Strong understanding of SQL and working with large datasets.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical collaborators.
Strong problem-solving abilities, with a bias towards action and a proactive approach to finding opportunities and challenges.

We’d love it if you also had:

Familiarity with the streaming music landscape or other digital media
Experience in finance transformation and EPM implementation
Knowledge of accounting concepts and revenue recognition principles

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Principal
new_jobs.description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

You’ll be part of PMG’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team of senior, customer-facing engineers that operate at the intersection of business problems, technology, and platform innovation
.

FDE partners deeply with priority customers, Vertical leaders, Client Strategy, Analytics, Product, and Engineering to solve complex, high-impact challenges that don’t fit standard playbooks. The team builds custom technical solutions, within the PMG Operating System (Alli), sometimes integrating with Alli from a sandbox environment, and sometimes outside the platform entirely. Remaining focused on driving meaningful business outcomes and shaping what becomes scalable over time.

This is a small, senior group designed for depth over breadth, operating where clarity is earned through execution, not documentation.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Forward Deployed Engineering Principal
, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with enterprise-level influence. Your work will center on solving real customer business problems through technology, not maintaining or extending a predefined product roadmap.

Partner deeply with priority customers and PMG leadership to understand material business challenges, constraints, and opportunities.
Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical approaches and working solutions.
Design and deliver custom technical solutions across data, measurement, workflows, mobile, and platform integrations.
Operate hands-on in solution design and build, using modern tools, AI-assisted coding, and best practices to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
Advise customers and internal teams on feasibility, tradeoffs, and technical direction.
Identify patterns, learnings, and approaches that can inform reusable accelerators or future platform capabilities.
Influence product and platform evolution by feeding validated insights back into PMG’s broader technology ecosystem.
Support high-impact moments such as strategic pitches, QBRs, and new business efforts where technical clarity materially changes the outcome.
Use AI, automation, and technology to elevate the quality and efficiency of work, streamline processes, and enable faster, more informed decision-making in your role.

What You’ll Bring

We’re not looking for a traditional software engineer profile. We’re looking for someone who is technically fluent, business-curious, and comfortable building in ambiguity
.

You’ll be successful in this role if you bring:

Strong technical literacy and the ability to design, evaluate, and build solutions without needing to be the deepest specialist in any single language or framework.
Experience solving real business problems with technology, not just implementing predefined requirements.
Comfort working across systems, data flows, APIs, and platforms, including modern cloud and measurement environments.
8+ year experience in customer-facing or consultative technical roles (e.g., forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, sales engineering, or similar).
The ability to reason about tradeoffs, feasibility, and risk when the “right answer” isn’t obvious.
A bias toward execution: you’re comfortable moving from problem to prototype to production quickly.
Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic coding tools, and the judgment to use them effectively within standards and best practices.
Strong communication skills, especially the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of influencing decisions without direct authority.
Curiosity, adaptability, and comfort operating where the path to value isn’t fully defined upfront.
An understanding that reuse, scale, and platform contribution are earned through impact—not assumed at the start.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards:
Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development:
Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off:
Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave:
Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits:
Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support:
Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare:
Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance:
Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account:
Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits:
Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities:
Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training:
Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

new_jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
new_jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.

About The Vehicle Generalization Team

Vehicle Generalization makes it efficient, scalable, and predictable to deploy Wayve’s autonomous driving stack across a wide range of vehicle platforms by making our core autonomy generalise as widely as possible.

We work across pre- and post-training to improve how well our AI models generalise zero-shot to changes in perception—including cameras, intrinsics, field of view, lens distortion, and calibration—and embodiment, including vehicle dynamics, actuation limits, and rig geometry. We also own the Generalization Benchmark, Wayve’s tool for measuring how models transfer across platforms. Our work goes into production programmes with major OEMs.

We’re looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer with a strong robotics background who understands how a real vehicle senses, estimates its state, and moves. You’ll identify where our models break down across platforms, understand why, and address those failures in training—then prove the improvement through rigorous evaluation.

🧠 Your day-to-day

Design and train models that are robust to differences between vehicles, using approaches such as conditioning or augmentation for vehicle kinematics and camera parameters.
Create benchmarks and metrics for cross-platform performance, translating results into clear decisions for model and platform teams.
Help root-cause on-road issues such as late turns, lane-keeping, and steering problems. Work with controls, calibration, and OEM engineers to separate model problems from system problems and identify the highest-impact model improvements.
Move research into production in collaboration with Driving Core and application engineering teams.
Support customer programmes, with some travel.
Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for ML engineering across the team.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

Pre- and post-training methods that improve zero-shot transfer across vehicle platforms.
Robustness to changes in camera configuration, calibration, vehicle dynamics, actuation limits, and rig geometry.
The Generalization Benchmark and metrics that measure how models transfer between platforms.
Real-world, multi-sensor driving data and the interaction between sensors, data, models, and actuation.
Production deployment of Wayve’s autonomy stack with major OEM partners.

🙌 You should apply if

You have several years of experience building and shipping ML systems in PyTorch and Python, including training at scale, debugging experiments, and rigorous evaluation.
You have a strong robotics or automotive background in areas such as state estimation, sensor fusion, calibration, vehicle dynamics, or controls.
You bring a systems perspective and can trace a problem through sensors, data, models, and actuation.
You have experience working with real-world, multi-sensor driving or robot data.
You communicate clearly across teams and are comfortable owning ambiguous problems from start to finish.

Nice to have

Experience with end-to-end or learned driving and planning policies, imitation learning, or reinforcement learning.
Experience with platform bring-up or deployment across multiple vehicles.
C++ skills and experience with on-vehicle or embedded deployment.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay!
If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution from L2+ through to L4.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working

This role is based in Sunnyvale, CA (preferred), or London. We operate a hybrid model that combines in-person collaboration with focused time working remotely. Some travel is required to support customer programmes.

🔍 The Interview Process

Initial call / recruiter screen — 25 minutes
Hiring-manager discussion — 45 minutes
Deep-dive technical interviews — approximately 4 hours total
Final interview focused on mission and values alignment — 1 hour

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (location dependent)

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working and access to vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development support
🩺 Comprehensive location-dependent health, family, retirement, and wellbeing benefits

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

new_jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
new_jobs.description:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will solve large complex real-world problems at scale, draw inspiration from the latest science and technology to empower undefined/untapped business use cases, delve into customer requirements, collaborate with tech and product teams on design, and create production-ready models that span various domains, including Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Reinforcement Learning (RL), real-time and distributed systems.

About You

Your work will focus on inventing and extending scientific approaches, models, and algorithms driven by customer needs at the product level, framing new research problems even when the problem is ill-defined and no textbook solution exists. You will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions that are deployed into production, defining system-level requirements and writing a significant portion of the critical-path code. You will develop reusable science components and services that resolve architecture deficiencies and customers’ pain points, while making technical trade-offs for long-term/short-term. You will work independently with limited guidance, and your decision-making will consistently incorporate robust, data-driven business and technical judgment. You will drive your team’s scientific agenda, author internal or external peer-reviewed publications that validate the novelty of your work, mentor and develop other scientists, and build consensus across multiple teams. You will have the opportunity to innovate, invent, and think big, and influence the experiences of millions of customers. We are looking for a results-oriented Senior Applied Scientist with deep expertise in ML, NLP, Deep Learning, GenAI, and/or large-scale distributed computation.

As an Applied Scientist, you will...

Understand complex, ambiguous use cases across the business and adopt/extend/design/invent solutions/models that are scalable, efficient, and automated, where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined
Work closely with fellow scientists and software engineers (at Audible and Amazon) to build and productionize models, and deliver novel and highly impactful features
Review models of peers for the purpose of reducing and managing risk to the business, while improving customer experience
Lead the design, development, and production deployment of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions for Content Understanding, Recommendations, and GenAI-based product features, defining system-level requirements
Drive and lead initiatives that employ the most recent advances in ML/AI/GenAI, drive your team’s scientific agenda, and author peer-reviewed publications
Mentor and grow scientists on the team and across Amazon, and push the boundary of innovation

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
PhD plus 5+ years of research experience, or a Master’s degree plus 10+ years of research experience in one of the following disciplines: Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field
5+ years of experience in Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing/Understanding, GenAI and/or Reinforcement Learning
Experience with Python, SQL, other scripting languages
Experience delivering science solutions into production systems

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
Author of publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals, cited by other scientists
Experience with building Recommendation Systems and/or large-scale content understanding systems
Experience with large-scale online experimentation / A/B testing to validate science solutions in production
Machine Learning Pipeline orchestration with AWS (SageMaker, Batch, Lambda, Step Functions) or similar cloud platforms
Experience with Agile Software Development, and programming in at least one compiled language such as Java, C++, C#
Experience mentoring scientists and leading science/design reviews across teams, and domain knowledge of comparable products (digital, retail)

new_jobs.title: Roboticist, Robot Foundation Model
new_jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About Our MEGA Team

Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA)
team within Wayve Labs as a founding member.

MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots
beyond self-driving vehicles. Our focus is on creating intelligent agents that can perceive, reason, move and manipulate the physical world across diverse embodiments, including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms and humanoids.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You enjoy working hands-on with real robots and are comfortable debugging across hardware, software, and ML systems.
You can move between research exploration and pragmatic engineering execution.
You have strong judgement around experiment design, data quality, and model evaluation.
You communicate clearly across research, engineering, and product teams.
You are excited by 0→1 ownership and ambiguity in a fast-moving research environment.

🧩 What You’ll Be Working On

Leading the development of an offline 3D reconstruction capability that builds high-quality 3D world geometry from vehicle sensor data in dynamic scenes. The system will draw on localization and mapping, state estimation, and sensor fusion to produce offline 3D geometric reconstructions and best-estimate ego motion from heterogeneous vehicle platforms and sensor suites. The work will support internal validation, data enrichment, and model development by turning raw sensor data into reliable, quality-assessed 3D ground-truth outputs.

🙌 You Should Apply If You Have

Experience in robot manipulation; working with robot hardware.
Experience with C++ and Python in robotics or ML environments.
Strong robotics and machine learning fundamentals, with the ability to translate research into robust systems.
Publications in top-tier conferences such as ICRA, CoRL, or IROS are highly valued.
PhD preferred; MS acceptable with strong relevant experience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More About Wayve

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

Initial call / recruiter screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.
Competency Interviews: programming and code review.
Deep-dive technical interviews: domain knowledge & system design.
Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually

📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve

✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs

📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth

🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Overview

JST is seeking an AI Engineer to help build a new AI-powered product from the ground up. The Engineer will use advanced AI development harnesses to move from product ideas to working software across the full stack, including cloud infrastructure, application services, data workflows, user interfaces, operational tooling, and software support.

This role is designed for a recent graduate of a technical master's or doctoral program who has strong engineering fundamentals and wants broad product ownership. You will work directly with the Head of AI Engineering, learning how to make sound architecture and product decisions while shipping useful, secure, and maintainable capabilities. You do not need to arrive as an expert in every layer of the stack.

This is a full-time remote, project-based position. You will report to the Head of AI Engineering and collaborate closely with product leaders, domain experts, designers, and other engineers through a distributed working environment. Joint Strategic Technologies's environment rewards practical experimentation, careful reasoning, and the willingness to work across conventional role boundaries. The team will expect you to use AI tools aggressively where they improve speed or quality, and to verify the result with the same care you would apply to code written by hand. JST offers a complete benefits package, a collaborative work environment, and strong company culture. Veterans and military spouses are encouraged to apply.

AI Engineer Responsibilities

Use advanced AI coding and engineering harnesses to turn product requirements, prototypes, and technical designs into tested production software.
Build complete product capabilities across cloud infrastructure, backend services, APIs, data pipelines, web applications, and user-facing experiences.
Design agentic systems that can plan work, use tools, coordinate workflows, retain appropriate context, and automate repeatable product and operational tasks.
Implement the controls that make AI systems dependable, including human approval points, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure handling, and cost and latency measurement.
Work with product leaders and domain experts to understand real workflows, identify the smallest useful release, and refine the product from user feedback.
Own vertical slices of the product from design through deployment and support, with guidance and review from the Head of AI Engineering.
Evaluate models, prompting approaches, retrieval patterns, and tool-use designs against practical measures of quality, safety, speed, and cost.
Write clear tests, technical documentation, runbooks, and support notes so that the product can be operated and improved by the broader team.
Investigate software issues, improve reliability, and turn recurring support needs into better product behavior or safe automation.

What We Are Looking For

A recently completed or soon-to-be-completed master's or doctoral degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, data science, robotics, human-computer interaction, or a closely related technical field.
Strong programming fundamentals and practical experience in at least one modern language. Python, TypeScript, or JavaScript experience is especially relevant.
A working understanding of APIs, databases, version control, testing, debugging, and the core concepts behind cloud or distributed applications.
Evidence that you can take an ambiguous problem, break it into manageable steps, and finish a working project. Academic, research, startup, open-source, and professional projects all count.
Clear written and verbal communication, intellectual curiosity, and comfort asking questions when requirements or evidence are incomplete.
Good product judgment: you consider the user's workflow, usability, reliability, and support needs alongside the technical implementation.

Preferred Experience

Two to three years of relevant industry experience. This is preferred rather than required; candidates with less experience and an unusually strong record of building and shipping will be considered.
Exposure to product development through an engineering, research, design, startup, internship, co-op, or customer-facing project. A previous product-management title is not required.
Hands-on work with large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agent frameworks, tool calling, AI evaluations, or AI-assisted software-development workflows.
Experience with a major cloud platform, infrastructure as code, serverless systems, containers, CI/CD, or production monitoring.
Experience building modern web interfaces or collaborating on UX, design systems, accessibility, and user research.
Interest in privacy, security, responsible AI, and the demands of enterprise or government software.

What Success Looks Like

You ship useful product increments that work across the interface, application, data, and cloud layers.
Your agentic automations save measurable time while preserving clear permissions, human oversight, and reliable failure paths.
You use AI engineering tools with discipline, validating generated work through tests, review, and direct evidence.
You learn the product and its users quickly, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and take on larger technical decisions as your judgment grows.
You improve the product after release by following operational signals and support feedback back to their root causes.

Required Clearances And Screenings

MUST be able to successfully pass a drug and background check

Join To Help Us

Scale a business that is a pivotal strategic bet for the company - today we feel like a ‘start up’ with the backing / support of a mature company
Help merchants customize and optimize their first-party digital shopping experience
Work on high-visibility initiatives alongside cross-functional leaders in product, engineering, and strategy
Leverage a data-driven approach to guide optimizing both your time and merchant resources

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

We’re excited about you because…

You have 6-10+ years of professional experience in solutions architecture (e-commerce experience strongly preferred), sales engineering, growth, product, product ops, strategy/biz ops, or technical GTM roles
You’re a strong communicator with high EQ. You can easily articulate complex technical details into business requirements and goals to help internal & external audiences quickly understand the “so what”.

You will partner closely with Life Sciences customer-facing teams, engineering, GDC delivery resources, and design to transform manual, fragmented workflows in Pharma, Biotech, and MedTech into automated, AI-native solutions. Roadmap and Solution Ownership

Experience with prompt design or agent-based automation solutions

Experience with network effects and cold start strategies for enterprise B2B solutions
Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification
Pharma, Biotech, or MedTech industry background strongly preferred

Success Metrics

Efficiency improvements and measurable reduction in manual work for Life Sciences customers
Blueprint adoption, usage outcomes, and business value delivered (e.g., cost savings, field force productivity, HCP engagement improvement)
Quality and clarity of roadmap feedback influencing LSC and Agentforce platform improvements
Time-to-value and scalability of LS-specific solution deployments
Customer satisfaction and depth of engagement with deployed solutions across the LSC portfolio

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . new_jobs.description:
At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI & ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build.

Team Description:

The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is currently working on building a new AI native platform to empower our broader business community to execute AI assisted analysis across our many lines of business. We are building an AI native, at-scale (15,000+ users at destination), enterprise platform intertwining deterministic code with non-deterministic reasoning systems as well as both frontier and home grown AI models, to transform how our company works in the data analysis space.

What You’ll Do:

Partner with a cross-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, agents and multi-agent workflows, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc.
Leverage a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more.
Invent and introduce state-of-the-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems.
Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One.
Set the technical direction for enterprise-wide AI architecture - unifying tooling, observability, and deployment standards across teams
Own the design and integration of model routing, caching, and orchestration systems that support hybrid and multi-model workloads
Champion responsible AI principles across all system design, embedding transparency, reproducibility, and fairness-by-design
Drive internal education, mentorship, and dissemination of best practices through architecture councils and AI guilds

The Ideal Candidate:

You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing. You want to work on problems that will help change banking for good
Passion for staying abreast of the latest research, and an ability to intuitively understand scientific publications and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
You adapt quickly and thrive on bringing clarity to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and digging deep to uncover the root of problems and can articulate your findings concisely with clarity. You have the courage to share new ideas even when they are unproven
You are deeply Technical. You possess a strong foundation in engineering and mathematics, and your expertise in hardware, software, and AI enables you to see and exploit optimization opportunities that others miss
You are a resilient trailblazer who can forge new paths to achieve business goals when the route is unknown

Capital One is open to hiring a Remote Employee for this opportunity.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 8 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies, or a Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields plus at least 6 years of experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies
At least 8 years of experience programming with Python, Go, Scala, CUDA, or Java

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience designing AI systems with tradeoff decisions around cost, latency, throughput and accuracy
8+ years of experience deploying scalable and responsible AI solutions on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or equivalent private cloud)
Experience architecting, designing, developing, integrating, delivering, and supporting complex AI systems
Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor multiple engineering teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders up to the VP level
Experience developing AI and ML algorithms or technologies (e.g. LLM Inference, Similarity Search and VectorDBs, Guardrails, Memory) using Python, C++, C#, Java, CUDA, or Golang
Experience developing and applying state-of-the-art techniques for optimizing training and inference software to improve hardware utilization, latency, throughput, and cost
Experience in building agentic AI systems and agentic workflows
Passion for staying abreast of the latest AI research and AI systems, and judiciously apply novel techniques in production
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex AI concepts to peers
Proven track record of defining and operationalizing enterprise AI architecture standards, including data pipeline governance, observability and evaluation frameworks
Experience leading federated or multi-cloud AI strategies to maximize resilience, compliance and compute efficiency
Demonstrated success influencing research-to-production promotion processes - guiding model handoff, evaluation and productization
Experience defining north-star metrics for AI systems that balance business value, innovation velocity, cost, and ethical responsibility
Experience right-sizing models, instance counts, and hardware types given requirements (e.g., context length, token inputs, token outputs)

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Lead applied research in one or more Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — and carry the results into the product. You will frame the problem, survey what already exists, build prototypes that test a real hypothesis, and measure honestly enough to act on the answer. The role exists because our advantage comes from turning advanced research into dependable mission capability.

Travel
: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

Frame research problems drawn from real product and mission gaps, define what a result must show to be worth productizing, and survey existing work before building.
Build prototypes that isolate the question being asked, at the fidelity the question actually requires.
Run rigorous experiments — baselines, ablations, held-out evaluation, and honest error analysis — with methodology another engineer can reproduce.
Build and maintain the datasets and evaluation harnesses your area depends on, including cases that capture known failure modes.
Report results clearly, negative results included, and make a defensible recommendation to continue, pivot, or stop.
Transition validated results into production alongside product engineers, staying involved through the handoff rather than delivering a notebook.
Contribute to the scientific community through publications, open-source releases, and academic collaborations, and advise Orbis on what in the field is worth adopting.
Travel up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of applied research or research-engineering experience, or an M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with equivalent applied work
Strong Python engineering skills, producing research code another engineer can read, run, and build on
Demonstrated experience designing and running experiments that produced an actionable conclusion, with methodology you can defend
Depth in at least one Orbis AI focus area: agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, or high-performance analytics
Working knowledge of modern LLM and retrieval methods and their practical limitations
Clear technical writing that makes a result legible to engineers and non-specialist stakeholders alike
Willingness to travel up to 20%

Desired Qualifications

Publication record, open-source contributions, or academic collaborations in a relevant area
Experience carrying a research result all the way into a production system
Experience with knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, reasoning systems, or information extraction
Experience with agent architectures, planning, or multi-agent coordination
Experience with model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation at scale
Experience with performance engineering on data-intensive or analytical workloads
Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
Travel: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

About Turing

Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com.

Role: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer — Enterprise AI

Location: New York City

Experience Level: 8+ years

Compensation: $200,000–$250,000 base salary + equity

Work Model: In-office, typically three to five days per week, depending on client requirements

Why Join Enterprise AI?

Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing, operating with the speed, focus, and ownership of a rapidly scaling startup. When it comes to applied AI in the workplace, you’ll define the frontier by building beyond it.

You’ll join the initial team of Forward-Deployed Engineers, shaping how we work while solving enterprise-grade problems for the world’s leading enterprises. As a Forward-Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll own outcomes end to end—from identifying high-value customer problems and shaping architecture to building production systems and working directly with senior client leaders.

You’ll develop generative AI solutions in the real world, driving measurable impact and return on investment within large institutions. Enterprise AI is intense, intellectually challenging work. It won’t be for everyone, but it may be exactly the challenge you’re looking for.

As a Forward-Deployed Engineer, You Will

Find the Problem Worth Solving

Work directly with customers to navigate ambiguity, uncover high-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and translate complex business needs into clear technical direction. This requires curiosity and business acumen as you discover business workflows and jointly define the outcomes an AI solution should drive.

Build Beyond the Frontier

Architect and build production AI systems, from multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to the APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and distributed systems that make them reliable at scale.

Own the Outcome

You won’t simply be given a list of responsibilities—you’ll have the authority to own the outcome for your client and make a real-world impact through your work. You’ll lead solutions from discovery through deployment and measurable impact while staying hands-on and owning evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost.

The Anti-Sell

High ownership and intensity: This role requires exceptional ownership and accountability. You’ll work with clients who have uncompromising expectations for quality, making this a demanding environment—and an ideal proving ground for people who seek difficult, high-impact challenges.

Client-first and in-office: Our work is client-first, which means in-person collaboration may be required either at the client site or at our planned Manhattan office near Madison Square Park. Depending on your assignment and client needs, you should expect to work in person three to five days per week and be based in the New York City area or within a reasonable commuting distance.

You’ll help write the playbook: Enterprise AI operates like a startup. You may not always have an established process or playbook because you’ll be expected to apply your expertise, judgment, and technical depth to create one.

Our Forward-Deployed Engineers Typically Have

Deep production engineering experience: Typically 8+ years building and operating sophisticated software systems, with expertise in Python, backend systems, APIs, databases, distributed systems, system design, and cloud infrastructure.

Hands-on agentic AI experience: Experience building production LLM and agent systems using orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, retrieval, and multistep workflows.

End-to-end systems ownership: A track record of taking complex systems from architecture through deployment and scale, with a practical understanding of evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, latency, scalability, and cost.

Exceptional customer and technical leadership: The ability to enter unfamiliar environments, earn trust quickly, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate effectively with senior engineers and business executives.

Client-ready communication: The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, navigate ambiguity, work with stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure.

Don’t Meet Every Qualification Yet?

If you don’t meet every qualification for this role, we encourage you to apply to our Forward-Deployed AI Engineer (In Training) opportunity.

This role is designed for high-potential software engineers and full-stack developers who are building the production engineering, applied AI, and client-delivery skills required to become Forward-Deployed AI Engineers at Turing.

Values

We are client first: We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
We are AI forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.

Advantages of joining Turing

Work at the frontier of AI, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first-of-a-kind benchmarks.
Contribute to leading-edge AI research and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS.
Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real-world business challenges.
Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies.
Move at the pace of AI innovation, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup.

Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

The Core Data Science team builds the products and data assets that let teams across Zoox measure and improve the autonomy and operational performance of our fleet. In this role, you'll develop the algorithms that run our robotaxi fleet: matching vehicles to riders and other missions, staging vehicles where and when they're needed, routing, and pricing.

You'll also model what goes into those decisions: rider demand, the value of the data our R&D fleet collects, servicing needs, and business inputs like events and policies. You'll be the optimization generalist on the team, working alongside specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy, and you'll see your algorithms run on a real autonomous fleet. You’ll join a diverse, experienced team with rapidly growing scope while working with one of the industry’s most valuable autonomous vehicle datasets.

In This Role, You Will

Design, prototype, and help deploy algorithms for vehicle assignment, staging, routing, and pricing
Model the inputs to orchestration (rider demand, data-collection value, servicing needs, events, and policies) as objectives and constraints
Work with specialists in marketplace economics, forecasting, and autonomy to turn their models into decisions the fleet acts on
Measure impact on revenue, utilization, and rider experience through simulation, offline evaluation, and online experiments
Contribute to how we evaluate and roll out orchestration improvements

Qualifications

PhD or MS with 2+ years of relevant industry or research experience, in operations research, robotics, controls, transportation, computer science, applied math, or a related field
Deep expertise in at least one of: combinatorial/integer optimization, stochastic optimization or control, reinforcement learning/approximate DP, network flows, or marketplace/demand modeling, plus the curiosity to work across the rest
Strong coding skills in Python, C++, or Rust; you write clean, tested, version-controlled code
Ability to turn ambiguous real-world problems into well-defined models and explain the tradeoffs to non-specialists
Good communication and collaboration skills

Bonus Qualifications

Internship or research experience in ride-hailing, delivery, logistics, or AV fleets (dispatch, routing, rebalancing, pricing)
Algorithms deployed in production or used on real operational data
Publications in operations research, transportation, or robotics venues

Steer customers toward best practices in measurement and AI adoption to realize the full value of Fin.

Experience applying AI to scale the data science workflow.
