new_jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Open Models
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help the world build custom AI? We're hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to drive technical engagement with partners and customers across NVIDIA's open model portfolio, including NVIDIA Nemotron and NVIDIA Cosmos. The mission is to turn open models into production-ready AI tuned to a specific domain, from post-training through harness optimization. We want any organization to build, own, and run its own AI on open source models, and this role helps the ecosystem get there at scale!

Unlike most forward deployed roles, our work runs primarily through NVIDIA's partner ecosystem. Our FDEs work side by side with top ecosystem engineering and research teams, co-lead joint customer engagements, and build the recipes and playbooks that help partners succeed and scale. We also work directly with customers when the work calls for it. Are you one of the strongest post-training applied researchers you know? Ready to take a model from a first customer conversation all the way to production? We'd love to meet you.

What you'll be doing

This role drives AI solutions from discovery and scoping through post-training, harness optimization, and deployment, working alongside partners and customers. Each use case becomes a post-training and harness strategy with the right methods, data, evaluation, and success criteria. Scalable architectures and deployment plans then take the model to production.
The work is hands-on, as we build together with the ecosystem. Custom AI takes skill across the full stack, and we work across all of it: designing evaluations, building synthetic data pipelines, and post-training with LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning (synchronous and asynchronous). It also means making the architecture and hyperparameter choices that improve results. We tune the harness (prompting, tool use, orchestration, and context management) so the model shines in a specific domain, and we optimize inference so it runs cost-effectively in production.
You will lead technical engagements by scoping the work, shaping statements of work, and driving delivery with partner engineering teams and joint customers. We scale our impact by building reusable recipes, reference pipelines, and playbooks that let partners succeed independently and help the ecosystem mature in building domain-specific AI.
We connect NVIDIA's model research to partner and customer use cases, unlocking the post-trainability and inference cost-effectiveness of our models, and work with our product, research, and engineering teams to bring field insights back into Nemotron, Cosmos, and our software stack.
Above all, we're excited to help organizations worldwide build, own, and run their own AI on open source models!

What we need to see

Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years in ML or software engineering, applied AI, FDE, or solutions architecture, including 3–5+ years of hands-on LLM post-training and taking models to production.
Solid fundamentals in deep learning and machine learning. Deep expertise in post-training methods, including LoRA/PEFT, SFT, and reinforcement learning, with an understanding of the trade-offs between RL synchronous and asynchronous approaches. Strong grasp of model architectures and hyperparameters and how they shape training outcomes.
Good understanding of large-scale distributed training and inference performance optimization. Ability to configure and tune workloads for memory efficiency, throughput, latency, and scaling across multi-GPU and multi-node systems.
Hands-on experience with post-training data, including synthetic data pipelines, dataset curation and filtering, and evaluation sets. Experience with harness engineering for LLM and agentic systems. Proficiency in PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, Python, and Linux.
Proven ability to scope an engagement, shape an SOW, and lead delivery with partners and customers. Excellent organizational skills, empathy for partner and customer needs, and the ability to drive complex decisions across teams and companies through trusted relationships.
Clear communication of complex technical ideas, from engineers to C-level executives. Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to partner and customer success.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd

A hands-on technical expert and problem solver who can clearly describe solution paths for complex challenges.
History of enabling partners and customers to successfully adopt open models and NVIDIA technologies and platforms.
A technical vision that influences product and engineering decisions and drives production outcomes.
Hands-on experience with Nemotron, Cosmos, and other open models, as well as both serverless and self-managed post-training platforms (e.g. Tinker APIs), including open-source frameworks such as NVIDIA NeMo and Megatron.
Experience with multimodal or world-foundation-model post-training, and running training jobs on large GPU clusters with SLURM or Kubernetes.

new_jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Data Processing
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is currently seeking a Solutions Architect for High-Performance Databases! Would you enjoy researching new algorithms and memory management techniques to accelerate databases on modern computer architectures? Do you like investigating hardware and system bottlenecks, and optimizing performance of data intensive applications? Are you excited about the opportunity to work on the top tier edge of technology with both visibility and impact to the success of a leader like NVIDIA? If so, the Solution Architecture Team invites you to consider this opportunity.

NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, revolutionized parallel computing, and ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can tackle, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human imagination and intelligence; join our team today!

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will research and develop techniques to GPU-accelerate high performance database, ETL and data analytics applications.
Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex data intensive workloads to ensure the best possible performance of current GPU architectures.
Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA
Influence partners (industry and academia) to push the bounds of data processing with NVIDIA’s full product line

What We Need To See

Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience.
Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software design.
Hands-on experience with low-level parallel programming, e.g. CUDA (preferred), OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, pthreads, TBB, etc.
In-depth expertise with CPU/GPU architecture fundamentals, especially memory subsystem.
Domain expertise in high performance databases, ETL, data analytics and/or vector database.
Good communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, and prioritization skills.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience optimizing/implementing database operators or query planner, especially for parallel or distributed frameworks (e.g. production database or Spark).
Background with optimizing vector database index build and/or search.
Experience profiling and optimizing CUDA kernels.
Background with compression, storage systems, networking, and distributed computer architectures.

Data Analytics is one of the rapidly growing fields in GPU accelerated computing. Data preprocessing and data engineering are traditionally CPU based and are becoming the bottleneck for Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) applications, as performance of the frameworks and core ML/DL libraries has been highly optimized leveraging GPUs. Many of today’s applications have complex data analytics pipelines that can benefit from optimizations in memory management, compression, parallel algorithms like sort, search, join, aggregation, groupby, scaling up to multi GPU systems, and scaling out to many nodes. Take a look at some of the open-source projects that NVIDIA employees have worked on: RAPIDS cuDF, NVIDIA nvcomp, NVIDIA Distributed join, NVIDIA cuCollections .

new_jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth
new_jobs.description:
Berry Street is building on the convergence of AI, GLP-1s, and the consumerization of healthcare — while leveraging insurance to make life-changing metabolic care as accessible as possible for all. Our platform connects patients with 2,000+ clinicians and AI tools to treat obesity, diabetes/prediabetes, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, maternal health, and dozens of other chronic and acute conditions, working with major health plans, health systems, and care management companies across all 50 states.

We launched in 2023, have served hundreds of thousands of patients, and are Series B — backed by investors like Khosla, Northzone, FJ Labs, and the founders of Revolut, Grow Therapy, and Spring Health.

About The Role

Berry Street grows through paid social, search, display, partnerships, affiliate, content, and lifecycle marketing, and we invest meaningfully in all of them. As we scale, the questions get harder: which of those investments actually create new patients, where the next dollar should go, and how to make every patient we acquire worth more. Ad platform reporting only tells part of the story.

We're hiring our first Growth Data Scientist to own how Berry Street measures growth and decides where to invest in it. Your mission is to grow patient volume while improving LTV and CAC, and to build the measurement and models the company relies on to do that every day, not one-off analyses. You'll report to our Head of Data, partner closely with our Head of Growth, and work across Growth, Product, and Engineering. This is a role for a decider and a builder: you bring a strong point of view, push it until it changes what we do, and help make the change yourself.

What You'll Do

Own how we measure growth. Set the standard for how Berry Street measures marketing impact, using experiments, incrementality testing, attribution, and MMM, each where it fits
Decide where the next dollar goes. Use the full toolbox (causal inference, Bayesian methods, regression, forecasting) to steer budget, channel mix, and creative toward more patients at better LTV/CAC, and turn open-ended budget questions into clear decision frameworks the company acts on
Make fast decisions trustworthy. Ads change daily and bookings come in fast, but a booking isn't a visit, and a visit isn't a patient who comes back. Make sure the calls we make in days hold up against the outcomes that take months to show
Build things that last. Turn your best work into production models and automated decision systems, including our in-house ad optimization process, that the team relies on every day
Look beyond your lane. The biggest growth lever isn't always marketing. It might be the booking flow, provider availability in a state, or the signal we send to ad platforms. Find it, make the case, and drive the change with whoever needs to be involved

Requirements

5-8+ years in data science or marketing science at a company with meaningful paid acquisition, and a track record of owning analytical work end-to-end and changing how money gets spent
A strong foundation in statistics: experimental design, causal inference, and predictive modeling
A deep understanding of marketing measurement, not just channel mechanics. You know what a multi-touch model can and can't tell you, when MMM is worth the investment, and how to check both against incrementality reads
Fluency in SQL and Python, and comfort building your own datasets from messy ad platform, product, and warehouse data when the measure you need doesn't exist yet
Technical rigor that holds up. You pick the right method for the question, know when good-enough evidence is enough to act, and build solutions that are statistically sound, reproducible, and robust to messy data
The ability to sell a decision: clear, persuasive recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences that actually get adopted
Bonus: Measurement in a privacy-constrained setting (HIPAA, server-side or consented tracking), or experience with value-based bidding and predicted-LTV signals. Our stack includes BigQuery, dbt, RudderStack, and Freshpaint

Who You Are

Proactive. You don't wait to be asked. You spot problems and opportunities before anyone else does
At home in ambiguity. Priorities here shift fast. You make progress anyway, and you'd rather shape the agenda than wait to be handed one
A systems thinker. You put effort where it compounds, and you build reliable, resilient systems that keep working as requirements change
AI-native. Agentic data exploration and LLM-assisted analysis are part of how you work every day. You're open to automating whatever should be automated, and you know where the judgment still has to come from you

Benefits

Competitive compensation package
The chance to drive impact in healthcare from day one, with direct exposure to company leadership
Comprehensive health insurance, including dental and vision
Light-filled Madison Square Park office
Generous PTO
401(k) with match
Citi Bike membership
Unlimited dietitian care
Continuous learning opportunities
Competitive salary and equity

new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The RL Teams

Our Reinforcement Learning teams lead Anthropic's reinforcement learning research and development, playing a critical role in advancing our AI systems. We've contributed to all Claude models, with significant impacts on the autonomy and coding capabilities of Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5.5. Our work spans several key areas:

Developing systems that enable models to use computers effectively
Advancing code generation through reinforcement learning
Pioneering fundamental RL research for large language models
Building scalable RL infrastructure and training methodologies
Enhancing model reasoning capabilities

We collaborate closely with Anthropic's alignment and frontier red teams to ensure our systems are both capable and safe. We partner with the applied production training team to bring research innovations into deployed models, and are dedicated to implementing our research at scale. Our Reinforcement Learning teams sit at the intersection of cutting-edge research and engineering excellence, with a deep commitment to building high-quality, scalable systems that push the boundaries of what AI can accomplish.

About The Role

We're hiring for the Code RL team within the RL organization. As a Research Engineer, you'll advance our models' ability to design silicon. Hardware design is difficult and unforgiving – exactly the sort of domain we want Claude to excel at.

You'll Leverage Your Chip Design Expertise And Turn It Into Tasks And Signals For Models To Learn From. Specifically, You Will

Invent, design, and implement RL environments and evaluations for agentic RTL generation, design (including formal) verification, physical design optimization.
Work on cross-cutting RL considerations such as EDA-tool latency optimization and proxy rewards.
Conduct experiments and shape our roadmap.
Deliver your work into research and production training runs.
Collaborate with other researchers and engineers across and outside Anthropic.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

Have expertise in ASIC or FPGA design: RTL, design verification (UVM, formal methods, coverage-driven), physical design (synthesis, place-and-route, timing closure), PPA optimization, DFT, ECOs.
Are fluent with industry EDA tools and processes.
Have taped out chips and have experience going from spec to silicon.
Know how to balance research exploration with engineering implementation.
Are passionate about AI's potential and committed to developing safe and beneficial systems.

Strong Candidates May Also Have

Experience with reinforcement learning, evaluations or environments.
Built tooling or automation around chip design flows.
Worked on ML accelerators or high-performance compute hardware.
Familiarity with high-level synthesis or architecture simulators.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. What You'll Achieve

Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.
Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.
Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.
Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.
Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.
Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.
Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.
Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

Job Description

Reuters Imagen is trusted by many of the world's most recognisable sports and media brands to manage and maximise the value of their digital content. Backed by Thomson Reuters, we're growing rapidly and investing in our technology, products and people.

As a Senior Solutions Architect
, you'll be the go-to technical expert for some of our most strategic opportunities. From shaping solution design and influencing customer decisions to supporting successful implementation, you'll have a direct impact on revenue growth, customer success and the future direction of our platform.

Key Responsibilities

Lead technical discovery workshops, understanding customer requirements, workflows, integrations, security considerations and business objectives.
Design scalable cloud-based solutions that align customer needs with Reuters Imagen's platform capabilities and best practices.
Act as the technical lead throughout the sales cycle, delivering compelling demos, handling technical discussions and building customer confidence.
Partner with Commercial and Account teams to develop proposals, RFP responses, statements of work, solution designs and effort estimates.
Advise customers on deployment, hosting, integration and configuration approaches, championing sustainable, configuration-led solutions over custom development.
Identify technical risks early, develop mitigation strategies and ensure smooth transition from sales through implementation and delivery.
Remain a trusted technical advisor for strategic accounts, supporting complex implementations, feature adoption and ongoing optimisation.
Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams, sharing customer insights, influencing product direction and contributing to presales tools, technical playbooks and market expertise.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in requirements elicitation, solutions architecture, pre-sales engineering, or technical sales support for enterprise or SaaS software
Demonstrable track record closing or materially contributing to complex technical deals in the US and North American market
Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, hosting architectures, and storage solutions (AWS and Azure essential)
Strong expertise in data modelling, cross-system data reconciliation, and integration design including API patterns, data attribute mapping, and business process dependencies
Able to deliver product demonstrations and handle technical objections from developers to executives
Experience creating technical proposals, SOWs, architecture diagrams, solution blueprints, and RFP responses
Comfortable operating post-sale in a technical advisory capacity alongside delivery teams
Fluent professional English; able to work independently in a remote environment and across time zones
Proven use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot for research, analysis, and workflow efficiency

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in sports, media, broadcast, or content management technology sectors
Knowledge of video codecs, transcoding, metadata standards, live ingest protocols, and content delivery workflows
Understanding of AI services and their application in video processing, automated tagging, data enrichment, and intelligent content discovery
Experience with Salesforce, Azure DevOps, and Monday.com
Familiarity with SAML/SSO, access control models, and security and compliance requirements common in enterprise media environments

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the target total cash compensation range for this role is $147,000 USD - $273,000 USD. Pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay and any target sales incentive are part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. Target total cash compensation ranges are inclusive of both base pay and any target sales incentive.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. new_jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Precise Software Solutions Inc. is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to provide hands-on, senior-level engineering for secure AI-enabled applications for the U.S. Government. You will add expert capacity during peak demand - major releases, new AI use cases, model retraining, and security testing. Working with the core engineering team and following the architecture standards, you will build and tune LLM, RAG, and agentic solutions, lead adversarial testing before releases, and serve as an escalation resource for production AI issues.

Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Must reside in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and be able to work on-site 3x a week at DC Government offices.

Must be able to obtain and maintain a NACI (Tier 1) background investigation.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, integrate, and deploy AI-enabled applications and services, including LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and agentic workflows.
Implement model evaluation, hallucination reduction, retrieval quality tuning, and performance optimization, and provide side-by-side model comparisons for major model or retrieval changes.
Lead AI-specific security and adversarial testing (prompt injection, jailbreak, data poisoning, unsafe output) before releases, and document and mitigate findings.
Enforce environment promotion controls (DEV to PROD), including security scans, testing, and TEVV gates.
Support MLOps workflows, including model versioning, drift detection, retraining, and release documentation.
Serve as a Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation resource for production AI issues, and support incident response and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to engineering deliverables such as RAG pipeline designs, AI system test plans, adversarial testing reports, SBOMs, and environment configuration baselines.
Conduct code and prompt reviews and mentor developers, applying the architecture standards set by the Lead AI Engineer.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems, or a related technical discipline and 5+ years of relevant experience. Three additional years of relevant experience may substitute for the degree.
5+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML engineering, AI-enabled application development, data engineering, cloud engineering, or software engineering, including direct development, testing, and operational support of AI-enabled systems.
1+ year of hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLM integration, RAG, model evaluation, agentic AI, or production AI systems.
Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing AI-enabled applications, APIs, services, and automation.
Experience designing and deploying RAG pipelines, semantic retrieval, vector databases, cloud-based AI services, and AI workflow orchestration.
Experience conducting AI-specific adversarial testing (prompt injection, jailbreak, data poisoning) and documenting mitigations.
Experience working in FedRAMP-authorized environments and applying the FISMA Moderate NIST SP 800-53 control baseline.
Experience developing AI-enabled user interfaces that conform to Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 A and AA, and supporting release management and operations.
At least one current Generative AI or Machine Learning certification (e.g., Microsoft Azure AI, AWS Generative AI or Machine Learning, Google Cloud, Databricks Generative AI Engineer, NVIDIA Generative AI, or CAIP), with verifiable evidence.
Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).
Must reside in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and be able to work on-site at Government offices.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a NACI (Tier 1) background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a related field and 7+ years of experience, including support of federal agency programs.
Experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and open-weight model serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI).
Experience with multimodal AI (document layout, OCR/vision, audio) and structured evaluation.
Experience supporting Authority to Operate (ATO) documentation and vulnerability remediation.
An active NACI (Tier 1) or prior federal background investigation.

ABOUT US

Precise Software Solutions, Inc. is a mission-focused technology services company delivering secure digital platforms, infrastructure, and operational IT services to government organizations. A CMMI Level 3–appraised company, Precise partners with agency technology leaders and solution providers to design, build, operate, and modernize enterprise IT solutions that support critical public missions combining agility, innovation, and performance to deliver measurable results.

Precise specializes in cloud and hybrid infrastructure, platform engineering, security operations and compliance, application modernization, and data platforms and analytics. The company is known for its agile, delivery-driven approach and innovative engineering practices, applying operational rigor and performance-focused execution to improve system resilience, security, and scalability across complex government environments.
